svg.title: Presales Accelerator architecture
svg.desc: How one discovery brief is produced: client, AgentCore harness and gateway, guardrail, three Lambda tools, DynamoDB, knowledge base on S3 Vectors, CloudWatch, IAM, Budgets.
svg.text: Tool Lambdas, one IAM role each
one role per Lambda, plus gateway, harness and knowledge-base roles
callers sign requests (SigV4); no API keys
separate bootstrap stack, kept by make destroy
Architecture: how one discovery brief is produced. Repository: discovery-brief-agent.
Independent portfolio project, not an AWS product. AWS and the AWS icons are trademarks of Amazon Web Services, Inc. Icons: AWS Architecture Icons, July 2026 release.
You sign an InvokeHarness call with your AWS identity (SigV4); there are no API keys.
The harness runs the model in a loop. Every model call is screened by the guardrail.
The model's tool calls go to the Gateway over MCP, authenticated with IAM.
The Gateway invokes the Lambdas: the profile once, two or three searches, the ROI once.
account_profile reads one row from DynamoDB (GetItem).
kb_retrieve queries the knowledge base, which uses S3 Vectors and Titan embeddings.
The brief streams back to you together with the tool results.
The client checks links, AWS services and ROI figures against the tool results.
